summary: Hydro One Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release about its 2025 Sustainability Report, highlighting safety performance, Indigenous procurement, and supply chain investments. The filing contains no M&A, activist, strategic review, or other special-situation event. It is a routine ESG disclosure by a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16, with no deal terms, board actions, or advisory changes. As a non-Rule 144A communications-only filing, it does not trigger any event-driven classification. This is a standard periodic update with zero special-situation content.
